verdict.rationale: Brex documents a broad API surface: Team, Budgets/Spend Limits, Expenses with receipt upload, Payments/vendors with ACH, wire and check, Transactions, Travel, Accounting, Fields, Onboarding and Webhooks, plus an official MCP server. The changelog shows the API steadily expanding (create user, archive and delete users, departments CRUD). There is no claim of UI parity, though, and several surfaces are documented as read-only or limited: transactions are view-only, travel only lists trips, and the Fields API supports only single-select dropdowns. Major UI features such as approval-flow configuration, expense policy rules, bill-pay AI drafting and accounting setup have no API evidence. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity commitment, write APIs for policies, approval flows and travel booking, full custom-field type support, and independent hands-on confirmation of coverage.
